OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

The implementation is complete. Here's what I changed to satisfy the spec ("When no registration date is supplied, set it to the server's current date and return `registrationDate` in ISO format `YYYY-MM-DD`"):

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a `registrationDate` property (`type: string`, `format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Because `Owner` inherits from `OwnerFields` via `allOf`, this field flows into both the request DTO (`OwnerFieldsDto`, so it can be supplied) and the response DTO (`OwnerDto`, so it's returned). `format: date` generates a `LocalDate`, which Jackson serializes as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

2. **`Owner.java`** — Added a `registrationDate` `LocalDate` field mapped to the new `registration_date` column, with getter/setter. MapStruct maps it by name automatically in both directions.

3. **`BuildOwner.java`** — The defaulting rule: after mapping the request to an `Owner`, if `registrationDate` is null, set it to `LocalDate.now()` (server's current date). A supplied date passes through untouched.

4. **`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — Added the `registration_date DATE` column (tests use `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema file must declare it; the others updated for consistency).

Results:
- `coreDefaultsToToday` (no date supplied → today) ✅
- `functionalityKeepsSuppliedDate` (`2020-06-15` supplied → returned verbatim) ✅
- Full suite: `Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — **BUILD SUCCESS**
